# Inputs to Specify

- Genotype matrix

- Heritability and optional pleiotropic or epistatic design

# Expected Outputs

- Phenotype matrix

# Limitations and Guardrails

- A statistical phenotype simulator does not simulate biological regulatory mechanisms.
- Check that generated distributions and effect sizes match the intended benchmark scenario.
